Commerce Layer — integration credentials

commercelayer/integration · version 1

envs add commercelayer/integration

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
COMMERCELAYER_CLIENT_ID required secret The same field name as the sales-channel template beside this one, and the opposite sensitivity. Commerce Layer calls integration and webapp credentials confidential, and confidential is what the second half below makes them.. where to get it
COMMERCELAYER_CLIENT_SECRET required secret Only confidential credentials are issued one. Its presence is what tells you which kind you are holding, which is why these are two templates rather than one with a footnote.. where to get it
